## Read in the data libraries and data
```{r}
# Read in libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(tmap)
library(here)
library(sf)
```


```{r}
# Read in data

rast1 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif')
rast2 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif')
rast3 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif')
rast4 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif')

```
```{r}
ext(rast1) # 02-07
ext(rast2) # 02-07
ext(rast3) # 02-16
ext(rast4) # 02-16
```

## Find locations that experienced a blackout by creating a mask

```{r}
# Combine rasters for each date 2021-02-07 and 2021-02-16

if (crs(rast1) == crs(rast2)) {
    print('CRSs match!')
} else{
    warning('CRSs do not match')
}

lights0207 <- merge(rast1,rast2)

lights0216 <- merge(rast3,rast4)

# Reclassify the difference raster, assuming that any location that experienced a drop of more than 20 nW cm-2sr-1 experienced a blackout

lightdif <- lights0216 - lights0207
lightdif[lightdif > -200] <- NA 
lightdif[not.na(lightdif)] <- 1

# assign NA to all locations that experienced a drop of less than 200 nW cm-2sr-1 change

# vectorize the blackout mask using st_as_as() and fix any invalid geometries with st_make_valid()

vectlight <- as.polygons(crop(lightdif,ext(-96.5,-94.5,29,30.5))) |> 
    st_as_sf() |> 
    st_make_valid()

# crop (saptiall subset) the blackout mask to the Houston area as defined by the following coordinates 
# (-96.5, 29), (-96.5, 30.5), (-94.5, 30.5), (-94.5, 29)
plot(vectlight)
# re-project the cropped blackout dataset to EPSG:3083 (NAD83 / Texas Centric Albers Equal Area)

# Exclude highways from the cropped blackout mask

# identify areas within 200m of all highways, might have to us st_union

# find areas that experienced blackouts that are further than 200m from a highway

# use SQL querey in st_read to only get highways and not other roads

# "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"

# identify the number of homes likely impacted by blackouts

# use SQL query in st_read to only get houses

"SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1`
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)`
OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')"
```
